title: ¡Rojito perdió sus ruedas! 🚒😱 | Canciones Infantiles #Shorts
world: bright toy town sandbox park (green hills, sandy play road, blue sky) + toy garage workshop with wheels on the wall

hero.who: The little red fire truck character
hero.one: Only one vehicle character in the picture.

story: Rojito drives happily, BUM! his wheels fall off and roll away (problem)
He tries square wheels: clunk clunk bump (wrong 1)
He tries tiny wheels: wobble wobble (wrong 2)
He tries giant monster wheels: way too tall, uy! (wrong 3)
In the garage he finds round red wheels that fit (the fix)
Vroom! He drives fast and happy on the play road (reward)
Nee-naw! Siren on, he sprays a rainbow of water (climax)
One wheel rolls away again, uy! (loop gag)
lyrics:
[Intro]
¡Bum! ¡Rojito sin ruedas!
[Verse]
¿Ruedas cuadradas? ¡Tun, tun, tun!
¿Ruedas chiquitas? ¡No, no, no!
¿Ruedas gigantes? ¡Uy, qué alto!
[Chorus]
¡Ruedas redondas! ¡Sí, sí, sí!
¡Vroom, vroom, a rodar!
¡Nii-noo, nii-noo!
[Outro]
¡Rojito al rescate!
style: High-end 3D animated preschool cartoon style, soft rounded toy-like shapes, smooth matte clay-like materials, soft studio lighting with a warm key light, pastel but saturated colors, big expressive glossy eyes, cute and friendly, clean composition, high quality render.
lock: ROJITO, a cute little red toy fire truck character with a friendly face: a short chubby rounded body like a toddler toy, shiny cherry-red paint, a big curved windshield with two big glossy dark-brown cartoon eyes with white sparkle highlights and expressive eyebrows, a small smiling mouth on the front bumper, rosy pink cheeks on the front, a small white ladder on the roof, one round blue siren light on top, a golden bell on the front, a small number 1 in a yellow circle on each door.

locations.parque: A bright toy town sandbox park, vertical 9:16 composition, camera low at toy level: a smooth sandy play road curving between soft green rounded hills, small colorful toy traffic cones, a little wooden toy bridge, round cartoon trees, a bright blue sky with fluffy white clouds. No vehicles on the road.
locations.taller: A cheerful toy garage workshop, vertical 9:16 composition, camera low at toy level: a wall with hooks holding many different wheels (square wheels, tiny wheels, giant black monster truck wheels, and round red wheels), a red toolbox, a small car lift, warm light from a big open garage door showing green hills outside. No vehicles in the garage.

shots: Extreme close-up at toy level: the little red fire truck character on the sandy play road with a shocked face and wide eyes, his four black wheels popping off and bouncing away in a puff of sand.
His wheels pop off and bounce away, sand puffs up, his eyes go wide in surprise.
Medium shot on the sandy play road: the little red fire truck character standing on four big yellow SQUARE wheels, trying to drive, looking determined.
He bumps forward clunk clunk on the square wheels, bouncing up and down with every turn.
Medium shot on the sandy play road: the little red fire truck character standing on four very tiny blue wheels, wobbling, with a nervous wobbly smile.
He wobbles left and right on the tiny wheels and shakes his head no.

Low-angle wide shot on the sandy play road: the little red fire truck character lifted very high up on four giant black monster truck wheels, looking down surprised and a little dizzy, the green hills far below.
He sways high up on the giant wheels and blinks down in surprise.
Close-up in the toy garage workshop: the little red fire truck character looks up at the wall of wheels and his eyes sparkle as he spots four round shiny red wheels on a hook.
His eyes light up with joy, a little sparkle twinkles on the round red wheels.
Wide shot on the sandy play road: the little red fire truck character with four round shiny red wheels drives fast and happy along the curving road, a trail of sand dust behind him.
He zooms along the curving road happily, the wheels spin, sand dust trails behind.

Medium shot on the sandy play road: the little red fire truck character with his blue siren light glowing, spraying a big arc of water from a small hose on his roof that makes a rainbow in the sunshine, laughing.
The siren light flashes, water sprays in a sparkling arc and a rainbow appears.
Close-up at toy level: the little red fire truck character with round red wheels, one of his wheels rolling away from him on the sandy road, his face making a funny 'oh no' expression.
One wheel slowly rolls away and he looks at it with a funny surprised face.
